title: alnus serrulata var. oblongifolia
intro: Alnus serrulata var. oblongifolia, commonly known as the red alder, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which provide relief from pain and reduce the risk of infection. The bioactive constituents of Alnus serrulata var. oblongifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
